answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the raven is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the zenith of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. Net effect on the hollow: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal utw4h.
